title: Once Upon a Farm CEO on Outlook Boost, Consumer Demand
summary: John Foraker, Co-Founder and CEO of Once Upon a Farm, discussed the company's strong 42% sales growth in the recent quarter and expressed confidence in sustaining this momentum due to resilient consumer demand across baby and kid food categories. The company has raised its guidance for the full year and anticipates continued growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Credit Card Balances at Pace with Inflation: Whitney
summary: Meredith Whitney, CEO of Meredith Whitney Advisory Group, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how many Americans are living payday to payday as well as how consumers are utilizing their credit cards. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Innovation Doesn't Happen Without Crisis: Rolapp
summary: Brian Rolapp, CEO of PGA Tour, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the changing landscape of sports media coverage, the rising costs of streaming bills for consumers, and the evolution of the PGA Tour after the rise and fall of LIV Golf. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Yen Jumps on US Data as Traders Watch for Intervention Clues
summary: The yen surged against a weaker dollar after an unexpectedly soft US payrolls report on Friday, with traders on alert for any sign authorities were preparing to intervene in the Japanese currency again.
